rows.constituent_figures_rules_reviewed: This skill computes Montenegro personal income tax for an individual or a sole proprietor (preduzetnik) for 2026. The tax is run by the Tax Administration (Poreska uprava). The currency is the euro.

rows.section: Principal independent activity and supplementary entrepreneurship
rows.constituent_figures_rules_reviewed: - **Who.** A principal independent activity is a registered business, a liberal profession (health workers, vets, farmers, lawyers, notaries, auditors, engineers, architects, advisers, consultants, translators, journalists and similar) or professional and intellectual services that are the taxpayer's main activity (art. 16(2) and (3)). Supplementary entrepreneurship is business carried on by an entrepreneur as a supplementary activity under the company law (art. 16(4), added by [160/25 art. 5][amend]). Supplementary entrepreneurship is taxed at a flat 15%: it does not get the 0% and 9% bands.

rows.section: Principal independent activity and supplementary entrepreneurship
rows.constituent_figures_rules_reviewed: - **Base.** Taxable profit is the income-statement profit adjusted under the PIT Law (art. 17). Income and expenses follow the income statement under the accounting law unless the PIT Law says otherwise (arts. 18 and 20(1)). Dividends and profit shares from other legal persons are left out of the business base (art. 19); this does not exempt an individual's private dividends, which are capital income under art. 37.
